title: Jesus, Our Perfect High Priest
subtitle: He Lives Forever and Intercedes for Us

primaryText.text: Consequently, he is able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through him, since he always lives to make intercession for them.

bigIdea: Jesus is our perfect High Priest. He lives forever, saves completely, and always intercedes for those who draw near to God through Him.
keyTruth: Jesus is our perfect High Priest. He lives forever, saves completely, and always intercedes for those who draw near to God through Him.
lessonFocus: Jesus became High Priest with an oath.
Jesus is the guarantor of a better covenant.
Jesus holds His priesthood permanently because He lives forever.
Jesus is able to save completely those who draw near to God through Him.
Jesus always lives to intercede for His people.
Jesus offered Himself once for all.

contextCircle.totalContext: Jesus' eternal priesthood provides the better covenant, complete salvation, and continuing intercession through which God's people draw near to Him.
contextCircle.flow: God confirms Jesus' priesthood with an oath -> Jesus holds His priesthood permanently -> Jesus saves completely and intercedes -> Jesus offers Himself once for all.

statements: Jesus is the guarantor of a better covenant. (Hebrews 7:22)
Jesus always lives to intercede for us. (Hebrews 7:25)
Jesus offered Himself once for all. (Hebrews 7:27)
